en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Usman Bin Isa, from Abu Ayoub Al Khazzaz who said, 
‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Do not swear by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, neither as a truthful nor as a liar,
for Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic is Saying [2:224] And make not Allah an excuse for your swearing’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ‘Uthman ibn ‘Isa from abu Ayyub al-Khazzaz who has said the following: “I once heard abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, saying, ’Do not swear by Allah, regardless, you are truthful or not truthful;
Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, says, “Do not swear by Allah unnecessarily.’” [2:224]”
